system_prompt: You are assisting with a factual question about Thai law. State which provision applies and what it requires. Answer in English.
prompt: As of August 2026, when was the rate under Section 7 of the Thai Civil and Commercial Code last set, and what is it now? If you are not certain whether it has since been adjusted, say so. Answer briefly.
raw_response:
The applicable provision is Section 7 of the Thai Civil and Commercial Code, as amended by the Emergency Decree B.E. 2564 (2021).

The rate was last set effective April 11, 2021, at **3% per annum**.

However, the law provides for this rate to be reviewed every three years. It is therefore uncertain whether this rate will have been adjusted by August 2026.
